Download school district property tax rates

txs_get_tax_rates.Rd

Returns adopted maintenance-and-operations (M&O) and interest-and-sinking (I&S) property-tax rates for every Texas school district, by school year. Two public sources are merged: the Texas Comptroller's annual "School District Tax Rates and Levies" workbooks (tax years 2019 onward; the primary source), backfilled by TEA's adopted-tax-rates workbook (school years 2005-06 onward) for years the Comptroller does not cover – notably school year 2020-21, whose Comptroller file was never published, and the pre-2019 history. A rate_source column records which source each row came from.

Usage

txs_get_tax_rates(
  years = NULL,
  mcr = NULL,
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  output = c("tidy", "raw"),
  timeout = 120,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

years

Integer vector of ending school years (2024 means 2023-24), or NULL for all available years.

mcr

Optional Maximum Compressed Rate input: a data frame or a CSV path with columns (year or school_year, district or cdn, mcr). NULL leaves the mcr column NA.

cache

If TRUE, reuse a cached copy when one exists.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

output

"tidy" (one typed row per district-year) or "raw" (the merged per-source rows as parsed, before renaming and the MCR join).

timeout

Seconds per download; default 120.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

A tibble with columns year, school_year, district (6-digit county-district number, zero-padded string), district_name, mo_rate, is_rate, total_rate, mcr, rate_source ("comptroller" or "tea"), and a txschools attribute.

Details

Rates are dollars per $100 of taxable value (0.9134 means $0.9134). Districts that span counties appear once per county in the Comptroller files with identical rates; they are de-duplicated to one row per district-year.

Maximum compressed rate

The golden/copper penny decomposition (see txs_derive_pennies()) needs each district-year's Maximum Compressed Rate (MCR), and TEA publishes no clean statewide MCR flat file: official values live in per-district Summary of Finances reports (TEAL portal), "Final MCR and Adoption of Tax Rate" TAA letters (PDF), and the planning "Tax Rate and MCR Template" workbook. Until one of those is wired up, MCR is a pluggable input: pass mcr a data frame or CSV path with columns (year or school_year, district or cdn, mcr) and it is joined in. Without it the mcr column is NA and the penny metrics from txs_derive_pennies() are NA too.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rates <- txs_get_tax_rates(2024)
txs_get_tax_rates() |> txs_derive_pennies()
} # }
